title: Parents, first instruments and learning bass from Billy Marrero
summary: Zardis's mother opposed music; he was an only child, played guitar with a cousin, and wanted to learn bass after seeing Billy Marrero.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
